item.title: BlackRock Files Tokenized Fund on Solana as Western Union Launches Stablecard
item.summary: BlackRock filed with the SEC to issue its tokenized BRSRV fund on Solana, Ethereum, and Tempo, while Western Union launched a USDPT-powered Stablecard across 37 markets on Solana — both highlighted in Solana's August 9 weekly recap alongside a self-reported record of 1.01 billion non-vote transactions in one week.
